usedFor: StoreHippo holds orders, users and products, and MailerLite keeps each buyer as a subscriber through “Create or Update Subscriber”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order” in StoreHippo, then “Create or Update Subscriber” in MailerLite
bestTemplate.why: The action creates or updates, so a customer who orders twice stays one subscriber.

watchOut: “User Updated” in StoreHippo fires on each change, so the same user can reach MailerLite again.
